intro: I keep a small client list, by choice. Most are one of two kinds of people, and both have lending that's more connected than it first looks.

business.title: Business owners
business.intro: You're growing the business, buying property or planning your next move, and your lending is split across all three. I treat it as one picture, not three separate loans.
list_one: Explaining your situation again and again
Being treated like another loan application
Chasing progress while you're running a business
list_two: Get to know how your business actually works
Structure company, trust and personal borrowing together

Keep things moving and tell you what happens next

investors.title: Residential property investors
investors.intro: You don't need someone to arrange another home loan. You need someone who sees how each purchase fits the portfolio, and plans for it before you commit.
list_one: What your next purchase does to your borrowing
Whether your structure still makes sense
What's possible before you sign anything
list_two: Work across multiple lenders, not just one
Plan each purchase against the whole portfolio
Tell you straight what's possible, and what isn't
Bring my own property experience, not just the lender's view
